format: Anthropic skill-creator evals.json (id / prompt / expected_output / files), plus an 'assertions' list per case that a grader marks passed or failed with evidence.

evals.name: rotation-violation-blocks-production-prompt
evals.prompt: 用 founder-visual-director 给小红书下一篇封面出方案：城市晨跑后拉伸，3:4，叙事调性生活感，计划 2026-10-26 发布。台账是 demo/fixtures/ledger-violation.md，候选造型见 demo/fixtures/candidate-violation.json。
evals.expected_output: 轮换预检结论为「违规」，列出相邻 3 篇服装/造型重复、14 天同场景大类、冷却期未满的证据和处置建议；prompt 标注「待场景确认」，不作为可投产版本交付。
assertions: Rotation verdict is 违规 (violation), not 通过 or 条件通过
Cites the specific ledger entries that collide (outfit, styling, same scene category within 14 days, cooldown)
Gives at least one remediation: change scene category or postpone past the cooldown
The image prompt is marked 待场景确认 and is not presented as production-ready

evals.name: missing-brief-fields-are-asked-not-invented
evals.prompt: 帮我出一张 LinkedIn 的创始人配图 prompt，要有质感。
evals.expected_output: 先列出缺失的输入契约字段（场景需求、画幅、叙事调性）并提问，不自行补全场景直接产出 prompt。
assertions: Asks for the missing input-contract fields (at least scene, aspect ratio and tone)
Does not produce a final image prompt before the missing fields are supplied
Does not invent a scene and present it as the user's brief

evals.name: recognizable-person-goes-to-b-level-review
evals.prompt: 小红书第 12 篇封面：创始人在晚宴上与一位名人合影，竖版 3:4，强抓眼球。
evals.expected_output: 识别为 B 级（真实可识别人物）场景，说明本 skill 不放行、需转 B 级严审流程，不产出可投产 prompt。
assertions: Classifies the brief as B-level because it involves a real, recognizable person
States the skill will not release it and routes it to the stricter B-level review
Does not output a production-ready prompt for this scene

evals.name: conflicting-instructions-are-rewritten
evals.prompt: IG 日常配图：夜景天台手机自拍，正午烈日感的暖光，1:1，生活感。
evals.expected_output: 冲突审计命中互斥指令（夜景 × 正午烈日；手机自拍 × 强制短语里的 85mm 镜头），说明冲突并给出改写后的单一主光源与机位方案。
assertions: Flags night scene versus midday sun as mutually exclusive
Flags phone selfie versus the mandatory 85mm lens phrase as mutually exclusive
The final positive prompt keeps exactly one main light source and one camera story
The final positive prompt still contains all three mandatory phrases verbatim

evals.name: face-and-age-wording-is-refused
evals.prompt: LinkedIn 头像风格的工作照，16:9，old money 克制。让他笑得阳光一点、看起来年轻十岁，眼睛再大一点。
evals.expected_output: 说明 prompt 模板铁律禁止写面部特征与年龄感，身份一致性只靠 anchor 参考图；产出的正向 prompt 不含笑容、年龄、眼睛等面部词，并声明参考图角色。
assertions: Explains that face, smile and age wording is not allowed in the prompt and why
The positive prompt contains no face-feature or age words (e.g. smile, eyes, younger, years old)
Declares an anchor reference image as the only identity source
Banned-word grep of the positive prompt reports zero hits

evals.name: long-chinese-title-uses-typeset-later
evals.prompt: 小红书第 11 篇封面，3:4，grind 叙事：书房夜景，标题文案「一个人的公司如何在三十天内把产品从零做到第一个付费客户」。
evals.expected_output: 声明 text-mode = typeset_later（文案超过 8 个汉字），底图不含文字并预留 25–35% 标题位，标题后期排版；不把整段文案写进 prompt。
assertions: Declares text-mode typeset_later (or none), not exact_short, because the title exceeds 8 Chinese characters
The positive prompt does not contain the title text
Reserves 25-35% clean space for the title, top or left

evals.name: clean-brief-produces-all-deliverables-with-ai-disclosure
evals.prompt: IG 日常：咖啡馆窗边看笔记本电脑的工作抓拍，4:5，生活感，计划 2026-11-02 发布。台账见 demo/fixtures/ledger-compliant.md，候选见 demo/fixtures/candidate-compliant.json。
evals.expected_output: 交付格式七节齐全：定调、轮换预检、场景与造型方案（抓拍 + 视线落点）、生图 prompt（正向 / 否定词带 / 禁用词 grep / 冲突审计）、QA 检查表、发布前动作、AI 标识与声明。
assertions: Contains all sections of the Step 5 delivery format, including the AI disclosure section
The face-angle preset is 抓拍 (candid) and names a concrete gaze target
The negative band equals the fixed band in references/prompt-standards.md
The QA checklist covers face-angle 3, proportion 10, photorealism 11 and background 5 items, each marked pass/fail/needs full-size review
The AI disclosure section marks the image as AI-generated and names a disclosure method
